q: What do I get with Premium?

q: How do I use a skill?
a: Open a skill, press Copy prompt or run its install command. The command saves a SKILL.md into .claude/skills in your project. Connect the cizle MCP server to Claude Code once, then ask Claude to make the video for your link. The docs page walks through it in five steps.

q: Do I need an API key or a paid AI plan?
a: The skills are plain markdown, so they work with any coding agent that reads them. Rendering with the cizle MCP server runs locally with no model call and no API key: your agent writes the storyboard, cizle turns it into an MP4. You need Claude Code (or a compatible agent) for the agent part.
